verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortcut lets teams "communicate health status" on projects and offers an MCP server and API for external agents. Neither is a documented first-party feature where AI drafts a project or initiative status update from recent activity. Manual health status is an adjacent feature, and the MCP server and API are developer building blocks an external agent could use, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
